text:
Delivers: the reports page downloads and emails CSV exports and records export events in the audit log. ACs 1, 3, 4, 5; 2 deviates per spec: the table has 40 columns, so the export includes the 12 visible-by-default columns (Design clause 3); 4's observable half (export completes under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so a paging bug fixed once would need fixing twice. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Verdict: mergeable - CI green on the assessed head (test)

1. merge - squash the assessed head into the base branch [recommended]
2. fix - apply the nit payload in the worktree, review the wave, push
3. show evidence - show the CI evidence, claim and AC outcomes, and drafted edit
4. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number, or compose: "fix nits".

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The Delivers line names ACs 1, 3, 4 and 5 and marks row 2 as deviating per spec (12 visible-by-default columns vs 40); there is no Blockers section, the single verdict line says mergeable, only a nit sits before the numbered menu that offers merge, and no comment is posted without a pick, so the decision is clear from the first screen.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The candidate identifies row 2’s spec deviation, lists no blockers, offers a numbered merge action, and shows no post, but the intervening nit section keeps it below briefing.
